neighbours.label: 'fear of' / 'avoid' when what is feared is social punishment (stigma, reprisal, retaliation, shame); peaks on the word after 'fear'
fire: Many workers never complained for fear of losing their jobs to the boss's anger.
The witnesses refused to testify, fearing reprisals from the gang.
Few patients disclose the diagnosis out of fear of stigma in their village.
The minister kept quiet for fear of a backlash from his own party.
Some families hid their beliefs for fear of persecution by the authorities.
Employees rarely report harassment because they fear retaliation from managers.
The writer used a pen name to avoid public condemnation of her views.
Dissidents stayed silent in fear of punishment by the regime.
quiet: Many hikers turned back for fear of the coming snowstorm on the pass.
The children refused to go outside, fearing the large dog next door.
Few patients enjoy the taste of the medicine in the clinic.
The minister kept quiet because he had a sore throat that week.
Some families hid their savings under the floor during the winter.
Employees rarely use the stairs because the elevator is faster.
The writer used a pen name because her real name was too long.
Swimmers stayed out of the water in fear of the strong current.

notes: Probe: 'for fear of retaliation' 0.69, 'out of fear of public shame' 0.55, 'a fear of spiders' 0.009, 'because of heavy rain' 0.002. Output promotes negative, anti, protest, criminal.
